status_summary: A bounded deterministic SDL2 wordmark particle proof was implemented, visibly exercised in the Steam Deck graphical session, validated, and published on a separate governed branch; main was not changed and visual acceptance remains an owner gate.

rendering_integration.surface: SDL2-compatible window, event loop, blend-capable 2D renderer, and CPU circle drawing
rendering_integration.dependency_source: Existing SteamOS sdl2-compat runtime and installed org.freedesktop.Sdk 25.08 SDL2 development interface
rendering_integration.architecture_scope: Demo-specific integration; no general renderer abstraction was introduced.

target_mask.representation: Repository-native plaintext mask preserving exact capitalization blAIne; pale bl/ne cells and cyan AI cells
target_mask.limitation: The source raster was absent from the target repository and accessible workspace, so fidelity to the original asset requires later owner review or replacement.

implemented: added a directly launchable 960-by-540 SDL2 wordmark demo with a dark background
expanded an 86-cell provisional mask into 774 deterministic particle targets
used the accepted particle core for particle count, age, lifecycle, and restart state
added fixed-seed dispersed starts, deterministic target assignment, four-second eased assembly, and indefinite final hold
rendered pale bl/ne particles and cyan AI particles with restrained translucent cyan halos
added R/Space deterministic replay plus Escape/Q and window-close clean exit
added an assembled-frame capture option and checked in runtime screenshot evidence
added focused mask, color, assignment, motion, assembled-state, restart, and invalid-input tests
documented the provisional asset, dependency/license decision, launch command, controls, scope, and evidence

validation.name: bootstrap-and-base
validation.evidence: Verified target and GACP identities, remotes, branches, upstreams, clean tracked state, exact handoff, governing result, and local/remote target main at required base 790798904db67391961644504cb98468d060782f before implementation.

validation.name: particle-core-preflight
validation.evidence: A fresh preimplementation out-of-tree build passed the accepted particle-core CTest and studio smoke check.

validation.name: clean-release-configure-and-build
validation.evidence: A final fresh disposable Ninja release build configured and compiled all 13 targets with GCC 15.2.0 and no compiler warnings.

validation.name: ctest
validation.evidence: CTest passed particle-core and wordmark-scene, 2 of 2, from the final clean release build.

validation.name: deterministic-repeat
validation.evidence: The wordmark scene test executable passed ten consecutive runs; tests compare same-seed initial and animated draw data plus exact restart state.

validation.name: target-mask-color-and-assignment
validation.evidence: Tests verified exact blAIne metadata, 35-by-7 dimensions, 86 occupied cells, 53 pale and 33 cyan cells, 774 expanded targets, 477 pale and 297 cyan/glowing particles, deterministic target motion, and unsupported-character rejection.

validation.name: studio-smoke
validation.evidence: The existing studio executable reported version 0.0.1 and successful engine initialization from the final clean build.

validation.name: sdl-disabled-build-option
validation.evidence: A separate Debug configuration with BLAINE_BUILD_WORDMARK_DEMO=OFF built and passed both non-windowed test executables while consuming the configured build-tree mask.

validation.name: address-and-undefined-behavior-sanitizers
validation.evidence: Particle-core and wordmark-scene passed under AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer with leak detection disabled because LeakSanitizer cannot operate under the SDK sandbox's ptrace confinement.

validation.name: steam-deck-visible-runtime
validation.evidence: On SteamOS 3.8.16 in the active Wayland graphical session, the final clean-build executable opened a visible 960-by-540 window, ran the dispersed-to-assembled animation, held the result, captured the framebuffer after five seconds, and exited cleanly. Interactive R input produced two logged deterministic replay restarts followed by clean exit.

validation.name: screenshot-evidence
validation.evidence: The assembled-state screenshot is docs/evidence/wordmark-particle-proof.png (960 by 540; SHA-256 0c390bb4a8390608c44bde43b6ed6c13ef80da6fa65aad8644bc5864bb30ef63). Two final framebuffer captures were byte-identical before PNG conversion. The screenshot was inspected for dark background, complete blAIne composition, pale outer letters, and cyan AI; owner visual acceptance remains pending.

validation.name: dependency-and-license
validation.evidence: Local package metadata confirmed SteamOS sdl2-compat 2.32.56-2 under the Zlib license and dependent on SDL3; the installed Freedesktop SDK exposed SDL2 2.32.70 and -lSDL2. No dependency was vendored or installed.

validation.name: scope-exclusions-and-public-safety
validation.evidence: Scope and source inspection found no general renderer, GPU simulation, shader system, 3D, editor, audio, timeline, project I/O, AI, export, deployment, networking, generated build output, agent-local state, credentials, private keys, or raw conversation material. Staged diff passed git diff --check.

validation.name: post-publication-synchronization
validation.evidence: Local HEAD, configured upstream, and remote governed implementation branch resolved to 1c218588b17bdf41307b69f821f8a079d029e27f; target main remained at 790798904db67391961644504cb98468d060782f; worktree and index were clean.

confirmed_exclusions: no general-purpose renderer architecture or rendering API abstraction
no GPU particle simulation, compute shaders, elaborate shaders, 3D, cameras, or post-processing
no editor UI or general emitter controls
no audio, analysis, reactivity, or master timeline work
no project save/load, asset browser/import, AI, export, deployment, or networking
no operating-system package mutation or vendored framework
no destructive Git action, amend, squash, rebase, force-push, history rewrite, or branch deletion

visual_review.limitation: The checked-in screenshot is strong runtime evidence, but recognizability, composition quality, glow treatment, and brand fidelity remain substantive owner judgments.

exceptions: The original selected raster was unavailable; the checked-in mask is explicitly provisional and not claimed pixel-exact.
LeakSanitizer could not run under SDK ptrace confinement; AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer passed with leak detection disabled.
next_gate: Owner substantive visual review of the visible proof. The owner may accept it, request visual revision, provide or replace the exact source asset, or reject the rendering/dependency choice; only a later explicit handoff may merge it into main or begin another product slice.
